expressions.name: Spark
expressions.expression:
count    = static.sparkCount
button   = buttonVars.sparkON
selfBuzz = buttonVars.selfBuzz
arm      = buttonVars.armIgnition
sparkon  = 0

button   = button or static.ignition

if arm == 1 then
 if selfBuzz == 1 and button == 1 then
    "DO:Spark" = 1
 endif

 if selfBuzz == 0 and button == 1 and arm == 1 then
    sparkon = 1
    if "DO:Spark" == 1 then
       "DO:Spark" = 0
    else
       "DO:Spark" = 1
    endif
 endif
else
 "DO:Spark" = 0
endif

if button == 0 then
   "DO:Spark" = 0
endif    

count = static.sparkCount
spark = "DO:Spark"
"DO:Igniter" = sparkon
sparkon

expressions.name: LOXFuelOutletControl
expressions.expression:
// Controls individually and together the LOX and Fuel outlet valves

runState  = static.testState
LOXOut    = buttonVars.LOXOutEn 
FuelOut   = buttonVars.FuelOutEn
fillTank  = buttonVars.FillRunTank
timedFuel = buttonVars.TimedFuelOut or buttonVars.mixedOut
timedLOX  = buttonVars.TimedLOXOut or buttonVars.mixedOut

lockout = static.startLockout 

if ( runState ) then
    lockout = 1
else 
    lockout = 0
endif
static.startLockout = lockout

goLOX  = 0
goFuel = 0

if ( runState > 0 ) then
    if (static.LOXOut) then
        goLOX = 1
    endif
    if (static.FuelOut) then
        goFuel = 1
    endif
else 
    if (LOXOut or fillTank or timedLOX) and lockout==0 then
        goLOX = 1
    endif
    if (FuelOut or fillTank or timedFuel) and lockout==0 then
        goFuel = 1
    endif
endif
        
"DO:LOXOUT"  = goLOX
"DO:FuelOUT" = goFuel

expressions.name: LOX Pressurization Controller
expressions.expression:
// LOX Press Controller
setP       = static.pressureSetPoint
manualVent = buttonVars.manualLOXVent or buttonVars.ventBoth
LOXMaxP    = static.LOXFillTankMaxP

enable = buttonVars.LOXPIDEn

LOXPress = "AI:LOX P"

LOX_Press_ON = 0
LOX_Vent_ON  = 0
if ((enable == 1 ) and (LOXPress < setP)) then

    LOX_Press_ON = 0

endif

if (manualVent != 0) then
    LOX_Press_ON = 0
endif

static.LOXVent  = LOX_Vent_ON
static.LOXPress = LOX_Press_ON

expressions.name: Test Sequencer
expressions.expression:
// Test Sequencer
// Uses a state machine to step through 
// shut off mixing, purge, mix on, pause, ignite
// run a set time, mix off, purge - done

static.testState      //idle

static.deltaTime     
static.preStartTime    = 500
static.prePurgeTime    = 1500
static.prePurgeOverlap = 0
static.ignitionTime    = 600
static.postVentTime    = 2000
static.postBleedTime   = 2000
static.postPurgeTime   = 4000
static.abort1PurgeTime = 1000
static.abort2PurgeTime = 4000
static.pressTimeOut    = 2000
static.runTime         = 3000
static.overlapRun

static.ignition      // these output to control expressions that take in buttons or sequence output
static.LOXVent  
static.FuelVent 
static.Purge    
static.LOXOut   
static.FuelOut  

startTest = buttonVars.runTest
abort     = buttonVars.abort or buttonVars.purge
purgeIn   = buttonVars.purge

TankPress = "AI:Ch P"
setP      = static.runTankSetPoint

IDLE           = 0
PRESTART       = 1  // condition on, press off
PREPURGE       = 2  // purge on, wait timed amount
STARTPRESS     = 3  // purge off, press on wait for press >= set point
IGNITION       = 4  // fire 
RUN            = 5  // wait run time, goes to POSTPURGE
POSTPURGE      = 6  // purge, goes through engine
ABORTPOSTVENT  = 7  // vent only, depress tank
ABORTPOSTBLEED = 8  // purge + bleed, clear line
ABORTPOSTPURGE = 9  // purge, goes through engine
ABORT          = 10  // go through the abort post events

state     = static.testState
deltaT    = static.deltaTime

purge   = 0
vent    = 0
bleed   = 0
igniton = 0

if ( (abort or buttonVars.purge) and (state) and (state < ABORT) ) then
    static.deltaTime = 0
    static.overlapRun = 0
    state = ABORT
endif

if ( state == IDLE ) then    // IDLE
    if ( startTest > 0 ) then
        static.deltaTime = 0
        static.overlapRun = 0
        state=PRESTART
    endif
else if ( state == PRESTART ) then
    mixon = 0
    if ( deltaT > static.preStartTime ) then
        static.deltaTime = 0
        state = PREPURGE
    endif
else if ( state == PREPURGE ) then
    purge = 1
    if ( deltaT > static.prePurgeTime ) then
        state = STARTPRESS
        static.deltaTime = 0
        purge = 0
    endif
else if ( state == STARTPRESS) then
    if ( TankPress >= setP ) then
        state = IGNITION
        static.deltaTime = 0
    endif
    if ( deltaT > static.pressTimeOut ) then
        state = ABORT
        static.deltaTime = 0
    endif
else if ( state == IGNITION ) then
    ignition = 1
    if ( deltaT > static.ignitionTime ) then
        static.deltaTime = 0
        state = RUN
    endif
else if ( state == RUN ) then
    if ( deltaT > static.runTime ) then
        static.deltaTime = 0
        state = POSTPURGE
    endif
else if ( state == POSTPURGE ) then
    vent  = 0
    purge = 1
    bleed = 0
    if ( deltaT > static.postPurgeTime ) then
        static.deltaTime = 0
        state = IDLE
    endif
else if ( state == ABORTPOSTVENT ) then
    vent  = 1
    bleed = 0
    purge = 0
    if ( deltaT > static.postVentTime ) then
        static.deltaTime = 0
        state = ABORTPOSTBLEED
    endif
else if ( state == ABORTPOSTBLEED ) then
    vent  = 0
    purge = 1
    bleed = 1
    if ( deltaT > static.postBleedTime ) then
        static.deltaTime = 0
        state = ABORTPOSTPURGE
    endif
else if ( state == ABORTPOSTPURGE ) then
    vent  = 1
    purge = 1
    bleed = 0
    if ( deltaT > static.postPurgeTime ) then
        static.deltaTime = 0
        state = IDLE
    endif
else if ( state == ABORT ) then
    static.deltaTime = 0
    state = ABORTPOSTVENT
endif

if ( state > 0 ) then
    static.deltaTime = static.deltaTime + 7.215  //Valid for 160Hz update rate
endif

static.ignition    = ignition
static.Purge       = purge
static.RunTankVent = vent
static.doBleed     = bleed

static.testState = state

expressions.name: Line Condition LOX
expressions.expression:
// Line Conditioning
// Conditioning valve on
// LOX Prop Out ON

lineConditioning  = buttonVars.lineConditionLOX
lineConditionFuel = buttonVars.lineConditionFuel
conditionBoth     = buttonVars.conditionBoth

runState  = static.testState
LOXOut    = buttonVars.LOXOutEn 

goLOX  = 0
bleed  = 0

if ( runState >= 1 and runState <=2 ) then   // PRESTART on, test sequencer in control
    goLOX = 0  // prop out off, this is purging before a run
    bleed = 1  // bleed valve
else 
    if (LOXOut or lineConditioning) then
        goLOX  = 1
        bleed = 1  // bleed valve on
    endif
endif
       
static.LOXdoBleed = bleed
if lineConditioning and (lineConditionFuel == 0 or conditionBoth) then
    "DO:LOXOUT" = goLOX
endif

expressions.name: RunTankPressurization
expressions.expression:
// Run Tank Press Controller
static.runTankSetPoint = 50.0
static.pressRunTank
static.runTankPressLockout

depress     = buttonVars.depressRunTank
autoDepress = static.RunTankVent
manualVent  = depress
state       = static.testState
TankPress   = "AI:Ch P"
setP        = static.runTankSetPoint
lockOut     = static.runPressTankLockout
RunTankMaxP = static.RunTankMaxP

if state >= 3 and state < 6 then  // PURGE complete, going to PRESSURIZE
    enable = 1
else
    enable = buttonVars.RunTankPressEn 
endif

if depress or lockOut then
    enable = 0
    lockOut = 1
    static.runPressTankLockout = lockOut
endif

if depress == 0 and buttonVars.RunTankPressEn == 0 then
    lockOut = 0
    static.runPressTankLockout = lockOut
endif

Run_Press_ON = 0
Run_Vent_ON  = 0

if (enable  and (TankPress < setP)) then
    Tank_Press_ON = 1
    Tank_Vent_ON  = 0
    "DO:PURGE"    = Tank_Press_ON
endif

if ( depress ) then
    Tank_Press_ON = 0
    Tank_Vent_ON  = 1
    "DO:PURGE"    = Tank_Press_ON
endif

if (TankPress > RunTankMaxP) then
    Tank_Press_ON    = 0
    Tank_Vent_ON     = 1
    "DO:RunTankVent" = Tank_Vent_ON
endif

static.pressRunTank = Tank_Press_ON

"DO:RunTankVent" = Tank_Vent_ON or autoDepress
if Tank_Press_ON then
    "DO:PURGE"       = Tank_Press_ON
    static.FueldoBleed = 0 //line condition valve OFF
    static.LOXdoBleed  = 0
endif

expressions.name: Line Condition Fuel
expressions.expression:
// Line Conditioning FUEL ONLY
// Conditioning valve on
// Prop Out ON

lineConditioning = buttonVars.lineConditionFuel
lineConditionLOX = buttonVars.lineConditionLOX
conditionBoth    = buttonVars.conditionBoth

runState  = static.testState
FuelOut   = buttonVars.FuelOutEn

goFuel = 0
bleed  = 0

if ( runState >= 1 and runState <=2 ) then   // PRESTART on, test sequencer in control
    goFuel = 0  // prop out off, this is purging before a run
    bleed  = 1  // bleed valve
else 
    if (FuelOut or lineConditioning) then
        goFuel  = 1
        bleed = 1
    endif
endif
 
static.FueldoBleed = bleed
if lineConditioning and (lineConditionLOX == 0 or conditionBoth) then
    "DO:FuelOUT"   = goFuel
endif

expressions.name: Bleed Control

// Control the bleed valve

doBleed = static.LOXdoBleed or static.FueldoBleed or static.doBleed

else
